title: Michael Penix: Being healthy was my target, I feel I'm where I want to be

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Michael Penix: Being healthy was my target, I feel I'm where I want to be
sources.description: Michael Penix is set to make his first start for the Falcons since last November when the team faces the Packers on Thursday night and the quarterback shared his excitement about that return during a press conference on Tuesday.
